review.note: A7: the record began in 1942, three years after its own cited article’s first sentence dates the beginning — "In Albania, World War II began with its invasion by Italy in April 1939", at revision 1376137340. The end stays 1944. The April is not written on the record: this atlas dates the war itself from 1 September 1939, and a month here would make a containment read as an impossible cause (rule 4). The edge into this record is disputed instead.

title: World War II in Albania
summary: The English Wikipedia article "World War II in Albania", at revision 1376137340, opens: "In Albania, World War II began with its invasion by Italy in April 1939. Fascist Italy set up Albania as its protectorate or puppet state. The resistance was largely carried out by Communist groups against the Italian and then German occupation in Albania." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q74109, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "involvement of Albania in World War II". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
